2.english_reference: for his kingdom was lifted up on high

traditions.VUL: genuítque fílios et fílias .
traditions.KJV: and David begat more sons and daughters .

4.english_reference: Now these [ are ] the names of [ his ] children which he had in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הַ יְלוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיוּ ל֖ וֹ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם

traditions.WLC: שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְ שׁוֹבָ֔ב נָתָ֖ן וּ שְׁלֹמֹֽה

traditions.VUL: Iébahar , et Elísua , et Elíphalet ,

8.english_reference: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי נִמְשַׁ֨ח דָּוִ֤יד לְ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל

traditions.KJV: all the Philistines went up to seek David .

traditions.KJV: And David heard [ of it ] , and went out against them .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ἦλθον

traditions.KJV: And the Philistines came

9.english_reference: and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim

traditions.KJV: and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .

10.english_reference: And David inquired of God , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤יד בֵּ אלֹהִים֙ לֵ אמֹ֔ר

traditions.KJV: And David inquired of God , saying ,

10.english_reference: Shall I go up against the Philistines ? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand ?

traditions.WLC: הַ אֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל פלשתיים וּ נְתַתָּ֖ ם בְּ יָדִ֑ י

traditions.KJV: Shall I go up against the Philistines ? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand ?

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֤ וֹ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵ֔ה וּ נְתַתִּ֖י ם בְּ יָדֶֽ ךָ

traditions.KJV: And the LORD said unto him , Go up ; for I will deliver them into thine hand .

traditions.VUL: Cumque illi ascendíssent in Baalphárasim ,
traditions.KJV: So they came up to Baalperazim ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכֵּ֣ ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִיד֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: percússit eos ibi David ,
traditions.KJV: and David smote them there .

11.english_reference: Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד פָּרַ֨ץ הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶת אוֹיְבַ֛ י בְּ יָדִ֖ י כְּ פֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם

traditions.KJV: Then David said , God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters :

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם הַ מָּק֥וֹם הַ ה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים

traditions.VUL: et idcírco vocátum est nomen illíus loci Baalphárasim .
traditions.KJV: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνκατέλιπον τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Dereliquerúntque ibi deos suos ,
traditions.KJV: And when they had left their gods there ,

12.english_reference: David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד וַ יִּשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בָּ אֵֽשׁ

traditions.VUL: quos David iussit exúri .
traditions.KJV: David gave a commandment , and they were burned with fire .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּסִ֤יפוּ עוֹד֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַֽ יִּפְשְׁט֖וּ בָּ עֵֽמֶק
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ συνέπεσαν ἔτι ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῶν γιγάντων .
traditions.VUL: Alia étiam vice Philísthiim irruérunt , et diffúsi sunt in valle .
traditions.KJV: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁאַ֨ל ע֤וֹד דָּוִיד֙ בֵּֽ אלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἠρώτησεν Δαυεὶδ ἔτι ἐν θεῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Consuluítque rursum David Deum ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore David inquired again of God ;

14.english_reference: and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר ל וֹ֙ הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֥א תַֽעֲלֶ֖ה אַֽחֲרֵי הֶ֑ם הָסֵב֙ מֵֽ עֲלֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός Οὐ πορεύσῃ ὀπίσω αὐτῶν · ἀποστρέφου ἀπ᾽ αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et dixit ei Deus : Non ascéndas post eos : recéde ab eis ,
traditions.KJV: and God said unto him , Go not up after them ; turn away from them ,

14.english_reference: and come upon them over against the mulberry trees

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ֥אתָ לָ הֶ֖ם מִ מּ֥וּל הַ בְּכָאִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρέσῃ αὐτοῖς πλησίον τῶν ἀπίων .
traditions.VUL: et vénies contra illos ex advérso pyrórum .
traditions.KJV: and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .

15.english_reference: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, then thou shalt go out to battle

traditions.WLC: וִ֠ יהִי כְּֽ שָׁמְעֲ ךָ֞ אֶת ק֤וֹל הַ צְּעָדָה֙ בְּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ בְּכָאִ֔ים אָ֖ז תֵּצֵ֣א בַ מִּלְחָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαί σε τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ συνσεισμοῦ αὐτῶν ἄκρων τῶν ἀπίων , τότε ἐξελεύσῃ εἰς τὸν πόλεμον ,

traditions.KJV: And it shall be , when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees , [ that ] then thou shalt go out to battle :

15.english_reference: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי יָצָ֤א הָֽ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ פָנֶ֔י ךָ לְ הַכּ֖וֹת אֶת מַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים

traditions.VUL: egréssus est enim Deus ante te , ut percútiat castra Philísthiim .
traditions.KJV: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines .

16.english_reference: David therefore did as God commanded him

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣עַשׂ דָּוִ֔יד כַּֽ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ הוּ הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: David therefore did as God commanded him :

16.english_reference: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּוּ֙ אֶת מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִ גִּבְע֖וֹן וְ עַד גָּֽזְרָ ה

traditions.KJV: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer .

17.english_reference: And the fame of David went out into all lands

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵ֥א שֵׁם דָּוִ֖יד בְּ כָל הָֽ אֲרָצ֑וֹת

traditions.KJV: And the fame of David went out into all lands ;

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יהוָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן אֶת פַּחְדּ֖ וֹ עַל כָּל הַ גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Κύριος ἔδωκεν τὸν φόβον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη .
traditions.VUL: et Dóminus dedit pavórem eius super omnes gentes .
traditions.KJV: and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations .
